tasks.title: Establish baseline and repeatable verification
acceptance: Run formatting, uncached tests, race tests, vet/build and Linux amd64/arm64 cross-builds on actual source; record platform/toolchain and blockers.
Confirm supplemental CI runs the verification script without weakening existing image checks. Fix proven baseline defects in small slices.

tasks.title: Implement private state access and ordered subscriptions
acceptance: Provide whole snapshot and entity read with atomic generation/revision and freshness metadata; missing entity differs from unknown initial cache.
Initial snapshot and subscriber registration serialize atomically against update, disconnect and generation publication.
Each visible add/update/remove increments revision within generation; new generation begins at revision 0. Ignored older/duplicate events and freshness transitions preserve position.
Independent consumers receive ordered add/update/remove, reset and freshness events; reset gives authoritative complete view or explicit resnapshot contract.
Reads, initial snapshots and events deep-copy nested maps/arrays; caller mutation cannot affect Runtime or another consumer.

Per-subscriber queue bounded by 256 events and 8 MiB canonical payload including resets/initial data; oversized initial view fails explicitly. Define bounded subscriber count and total resource budget.
Overflow terminates only slow subscriber visibly; cancellation and Runtime shutdown have distinct terminal outcomes, no send/close races or leaks.
Keep Changes as coarse status notifications. No public endpoints, modules, HA actions, history or persistence.
Update internal contract ADR/spec and cover atomicity, ownership, reset/backpressure under race tests. Proposed package internal/state is optional; choose clean actual boundaries.

tasks.title: Prove reconciliation and accounting invariants
acceptance: Add bounded fuzz/model tests for add/update/remove/recreate, duplicates, ambiguous equal/older timestamps, malformed/deep attributes and count/byte boundaries.
Failed candidates never replace published generation; detected live failure leaves retained state stale.
Assert payload accounting and subscriber ownership with an independent behavioral oracle. Use deterministic coordination, run limited reproducible fuzz smoke, retain failing seeds.

tasks.title: Measure contention and harden whole-process shutdown
acceptance: Benchmark synthetic small/large/near-limit cache reads/copies/deltas; report allocations, memory amplification and update delay under concurrent reads.
Exercise cancellation during dial/auth/subscribe/snapshot/replay/live ping and near-limit copy.
Measure entire process exit against 10-second Supervisor grant, separately from HTTP 8-second budget; fix demonstrated stalls/leaks/violations while preserving ownership and atomicity.
Record developer-host provisional budgets and limitations; do not claim appliance readiness.

tasks.title: Resolve legacy diagnostic probe ownership
acceptance: Trace all probe/monitor callers and document intended diagnostic use or remove proven dead code with focused tests.
REST never overrides operational WebSocket readiness/freshness; no new credentials or surface.

tasks.title: Create repeatable HAOS validation and recovery runbook
acceptance: Provide synthetic setup and expected outcomes for startup without Bridge/modules/cloud, deny/recover, Core restart/resync, burst/overflow, ingress/watchdog and shutdown.
Define evidence fields for exact HAOS/Core versions, architecture/hardware and latency/memory/reconnect/exit measurements.
Keep recovery local; do not operate real home automatically. Docker image builds are distinct from HAOS acceptance.

tasks.title: Execute supported HAOS and appliance validation
tasks.blocker: No authorized clean HAOS/appliance target or test access. Attach one with exact HAOS/Core/Supervisor versions and run docs/agent/HAOS-VALIDATION.md; Docker/fake transport is insufficient.
acceptance: Run R06 on an available authorized clean HAOS test environment and record exact versions/architecture.
Validate current ingestion, ingress filter and restart/recovery; record appliance-specific evidence separately.
If no test environment is available, mark blocked with concrete restart condition and continue proposals. Never substitute fake transport/image builds for HAOS acceptance.

tasks.title: Propose public consumer and HA action contracts
acceptance: Define version/compatibility negotiation, transport options, scoped state/events, readiness/staleness, deadlines/backpressure and disconnect recovery.
Define actor/grant enforcement, service acceptance versus observed outcome and unknown/timeouts; no blind retry of uncertain actions.
List registry/service discovery and generated Go binding requirements without implementing them.
Produce concrete recommended schemas/examples, alternatives, migration and adversarial test plan. Keep Status Proposed.

tasks.title: Propose containment, trust and safe activation
acceptance: Threat model child access to environment/files/network; separate processes and non-root alone do not enforce grants.
Compare feasible HAOS containment/resource limits; never share Supervisor token with modules.
Define manifest/provenance/signatures/source approval, staged installation, health gates, crash-loop quarantine and rollback.
Define single-active fencing, drain, timer ownership, uncertain in-flight actions and recovery after Runtime restart.
Separate Supervisor-owned Runtime recovery/self-update from module deployment. Keep Status Proposed.

tasks.title: Propose optional Bridge compatibility and fallback
acceptance: Define cross-container transport/topology options, authentication, version/capability negotiation, discovery enrichment and heartbeat/reconnect.
One authoritative state source at a time; generation reset on source switching, graceful fallback to existing HA path.
Python integration belongs to a separate repository; Bridge never becomes boot dependency. Keep Status Proposed.

tasks.title: Complete packaging verification with mounted builder CA trust
acceptance: Support optional BuildKit CA trust for managed-proxy image checks without disabling TLS or embedding the worker certificate in final images.
Run the full verification script with both HAOS image architectures and inspect final scratch image permissions/contents; record registry recovery and distinguish builds from HAOS acceptance.

tasks.title: Define and prove bounded inherited module protocol
acceptance: Implement a versioned bounded module codec/session over an injected full-duplex connection; production launcher transport may follow in M03.
Cover hello negotiation, incompatible major/required capability, malformed/oversized/deep frames, deadlines, cancellation and bounded writes with synthetic peers.
Represent module identity/version and boot/generation lifecycle server-side; no claimed peer identity grants authority and no HA/Supervisor credential crosses the boundary.
Do not implement downloads, production module execution, HA actions or Bridge.

tasks.title: Expose canonical HA state protocol to managed modules
acceptance: Define canonical generic entity/state payloads that preserve unknown HA domains/attributes while structuring known identity/state/freshness fields.
Expose complete reset then ordered deltas without per-entity grant filtering; source generation/freshness transitions are explicit and invisible changes do not invent semantics.
Bound reset staging, stream queues and transport memory; slow consumers cannot stall HA ingestion and disconnect requires a new complete reset.
Use deterministic race/model tests for reset versus live update/disconnect and deep ownership.

tasks.title: Implement durable execution timeline and replay
acceptance: Implement crash-safe durable schedule/timeline metadata and a watermark sufficient to reconstruct deterministic Runtime-owned occurrences after restart.
Provide a global recovery horizon plus per-schedule override bounded by a Runtime maximum; replay retains original logical occurrence time and recovered metadata.
Do not fabricate HA events missed while offline and do not persist HA entity history.
Fault-test partial writes/corruption/disk-full behavior and deterministic restart/replay without wall-clock sleeps.

tasks.title: Implement trigger admission and execution modes
acceptance: Implement bounded single, restart, queued and parallel admission semantics with execution IDs and explicit pending/running/terminal state.
Cron/delayed occurrences use the same admission path; define deterministic cancellation, concurrency, queue and expiry behavior in internal docs/tests.
Persist enough mode state for Runtime restart without duplicate admission.
Model-test event sequences and queue/concurrency boundaries.

tasks.title: Implement trusted module process launcher
acceptance: Launch only explicit local synthetic fixtures in tests; create private inherited socketpair/descriptor IPC and close unrelated descriptors/environment secrets.
Track child generation/process ownership and prove cancel/kill/join behavior without making child failure Runtime failure.
Add practical resource observation/bounds available on developer Linux without claiming HAOS sandbox enforcement.
No network download, catalog install or production module artifact execution in this slice.

tasks.title: Implement zero-downtime generation router
acceptance: Keep v1 active while v2 prepares; v2 cannot receive new work until explicit ready-and-accepting acknowledgement.
Perform one atomic admission cutover: all new execution tokens route to v2 while v1 drains only pre-cutover work.
An occurrence racing cutover is delivered exactly once; no automatic fallback after cutover.
Candidate failure before cutover leaves v1 active; deterministic race/model tests prove no dual admission and bounded drain.

tasks.title: Implement per-generation state and negotiated handover
acceptance: Allocate isolated writable state storage per module generation; preparing candidate cannot mutate active generation state.
Implement optional bounded opaque handover negotiation with source version/schema metadata; protocol support does not imply state compatibility.
Support initial warm-up transfer plus a short final consistent handover barrier before cutover when negotiated.
Test compatible migration, explicit incompatible clean start, required-state refusal, concurrent mutation and failed candidate without corrupting v1.

tasks.title: Implement retention, manual rollback and quarantine
acceptance: Retain current plus immediately previous successful artifact/state generation; older retired generation becomes deletable after next successful activation.
Manual rollback is a new prepared generation/epoch using the same readiness/cutover rules; never resurrect stale process authority.
Restart only the selected active version with bounded exponential backoff and finite retry budget; terminal exhaustion enters QUARANTINED.
Quarantine performs no automatic restart/rollback and does not impair Runtime or unrelated modules; test crash storms and operator recovery hooks.

tasks.title: Implement fenced HA action outcomes
acceptance: Add an internal action gateway behind the canonical module protocol using only fake/injected HA action transport in tests.
Only active generation admits new actions; draining generation may finish only pre-cutover admitted work.
Represent not_sent, accepted, rejected_by_ha and unknown distinctly; optional observed result is evidence not causality.
Never blindly retry unknown; persist/recover uncertainty required across Runtime restart and test disconnect/timeout/cutover races.
No production real-home action acceptance test in this slice.

tasks.title: Implement official package and manifest verification foundation
acceptance: Define source-neutral manifest/package metadata for official modules including identity/version/arch/protocol compatibility and declared capabilities.
Verify signed local test catalog/manifest/artifact fixtures and digests offline; reject tampering, wrong identity/version/arch and compatibility mismatch.
Expose install/update review data without treating declarations as fine-grained authorization.
Do not implement arbitrary repositories, unsigned bypass, production downloader or unattended installation.

tasks.title: Prototype stable discovery bindings and generic escape hatch
acceptance: Define sanitized discovery snapshot model supporting stable provider identity where HA supplies it and explicit weak identity otherwise.
Prototype deterministic Go binding generation for known entities/services while preserving generic unknown-domain/service access.
Persist binding identity so HA entity/display rename does not silently rename/break an established Go symbol.
Use synthetic discovery only; do not commit real household identifiers or generated private-home files.

tasks.title: Implement optional Bridge negotiation client
acceptance: Implement Bridge hello/capability negotiation behind an injected Core WebSocket-style transport with shared fixture schemas suitable for the Python repository.
Absent, denied, incompatible, malformed or timed-out Bridge remains optional and cannot degrade native HA state/process health.
Represent absent/incompatible/available/temporarily-unavailable capability status without installing Bridge or broadening credentials.
Do not implement selected Bridge state source until server-side barrier/sequence evidence exists.

tasks.title: Implement Bridge discovery normalization
acceptance: Normalize richer Bridge registry/service discovery into the same canonical discovery model used by native HA.
Preserve missing, unsupported, permission-redacted and weak/stable identity distinctions; bound requests/chunks/total memory.
Bridge enrichment may improve generated bindings but modules never receive a Bridge-specific model.
Use synthetic/versioned fixtures; Python implementation remains separately owned.

tasks.title: Implement Bridge-preferred atomic source switching
tasks.blocker: Requires version-pinned Python Bridge evidence/fixtures proving ordered-state complete snapshot barrier, bounded buffering and contiguous sequence semantics before Runtime may prefer Bridge state.
acceptance: Prepare Bridge candidate while native source remains authoritative; atomically publish only a complete proven candidate as a new generation.
Fence old writer; late events cannot mutate selected generation; never merge native and Bridge streams.
Selected Bridge failure marks state stale and performs complete native resynchronization/fallback; later Bridge re-entry requires a fresh complete candidate.
Cross-repository compatibility and HAOS fault evidence are required before claiming production readiness.

tasks.title: Validate managed module lifecycle on HAOS
tasks.blocker: Requires an authorized disposable HAOS target with exact HAOS/Core/Supervisor versions and test access. Synthetic/Linux evidence is insufficient.
acceptance: Validate inherited IPC/process lifecycle, zero-downtime cutover/drain, restart/quarantine, storage persistence and Runtime shutdown on HAOS.
Measure resource behavior and verify module crash/pressure does not make Runtime unavailable within supported limits.
Use synthetic modules and fake/safe HA actions only; do not operate the real home.
Record VM versus appliance evidence separately.
